Domestic supply therefore recorded as unknown, not as confirmed.

OF DISC BRAKE PADS)", "BOLTS B16 (RAW MATERIAL USE FOR MANUFACTURING OF DISC BRAKE PADS)"), and the export rows are finished brake pads/linings under its own invoice series (EX1225..., EX3125...), so this is a producer, not a pure trader. HS check: declared 870830 matches the actual export records (87083000 disc brake pads, brake pads for trailers/trucks); a secondary line 68138900 (brake linings) also appears, so the declared code is correct for the main product and no correction is needed. Export status is confirmed by dated customs rows with B/L numbers, not by website claims. Domestic status is unknown purely because of access blocks, not because supply is absent — absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence, and no 'declared_only' softening is applied. Revenue and export volume figures: null — no public figure was retrieved and none is invented. PAN AAACA0494M and CIN were not verifiable from any reachable source, so they are not confirmed here. No sanctions/court/owner-criminal matters were assessed (out of scope per project rules and not a rejection ground). Verdict basis: entity exists and is actively shipping, so no rejection ground applies.
